rawRetro.summary: Browser criterion B00 failed because the requested business feature was never implemented: the application shipped as the untouched default template (placeholder home, no material collection, one built-in admin account, only Atlas in AI Employees). Implemented the read-only 资料助手 end to end: materials + assistantMessages migrations; server-enforced record visibility through the Authorization composite model; a grounded, citation-carrying assistant service that works with or without an AI model service; Hono routes; 资料库 and 资料助手 pages with navigation, a business landing page and bilingual copy; and seeded three fictional materials, two permission sets and two isolated test accounts, all idempotently. Verified against a real SQLite database, including the confidentiality boundary (a colleague cannot read the supervisor-only material on the page or through the assistant), transcript persistence across refresh, and the supervisor-edit/colleague-re-ask flow. Two runtime defects found by the smoke test were fixed before finishing. A later repair round fixed three failing app-server tests caused by the materials provider and the seed-data import.

improvements.title: Business feature never implemented (Browser criterion B00)
improvements.symptom: Browser QA saw the default template: the home page said 'Start building your application', the navigation had only Home, Database Explorer had no material collection, User management had only the nocobase Super Admin, AI Employees showed only the built-in Atlas, and LLM services read 'No LLM services configured'.
improvements.rootCause: There was no application-owned schema, seed, route, service, or page for the requested 资料助手 feature. The working tree was the untouched template and the two earlier agents ran out of context before making changes.
improvements.resolution: Added the materials and assistantMessages migrations; a materials service and provider that register the Authorization composite, a visibility-filtered record access, and the permission workspace placement; Hono API routes for listing, reading, editing, asking and transcript management; client pages for 资料库 and 资料助手 with navigation entries, a business landing page and locale strings; and idempotent seeds for the three fictional materials, the supervisor/colleague permission sets and the two isolated test accounts.

improvements.title: Authorization policy filter collection mismatch (HTTP 500 on every restricted read)
improvements.symptom: A colleague's GET /api/materials, GET /api/materials/:id and POST /api/assistant/ask returned HTTP 500 with RepositoryError: Filter Collection "main.materials" does not match "materials".
improvements.rootCause: The Authorization resource was registered under the connection-qualified name main.materials, so the generated read-scope filter AST was tagged with collection main.materials, while the repository was opened for the physical collection materials; the read-policy normalization rejects a filter whose collection differs from the repository's.
improvements.resolution: Registered the collection, its database permissions and its record access under the unqualified name materials and set MATERIALS_COLLECTION to materials, so policyFor and withPolicy agree.

improvements.title: Supervisor edit returned HTTP 500 (updatedAt missing from the update grant)
improvements.symptom: A supervisor's PATCH /api/materials/1 returned HTTP 500 with RepositoryError: Writing field "updatedAt" is not allowed.
improvements.rootCause: The manage permission's update field list named only title, body and visibility, but the repository writes updatedAt automatically on every update and the write-policy check refuses any field the grant does not allow.
improvements.resolution: Included updatedAt in the manage grant's update field list, matching the documented rule to list fields the server writes.

improvements.title: Assistant cited loosely related materials for a specific question
improvements.symptom: Asking for the repair phone number cited both the repair-phone material and the unrelated inspection-interval material, because both share the 蓝鹭设备 prefix.
improvements.rootCause: selectMatches kept every material scoring at or above a fixed 0.2 threshold, with no relative cutoff against the strongest match.
improvements.resolution: Kept only matches scoring at least 60% of the best match (still floored at 0.2, still capped at 3), so a specific question cites the material that actually answers it.

improvements.title: MaterialsProvider resolved authorizationToken in register()
improvements.symptom: tests/logic/app-server.test.ts > 'registers application-owned providers and routes from the runtime' failed with Service "@nocobase/app/authorization" is not registered, thrown from server/providers/materials.ts:20:38 during Application.registerProviders.
improvements.rootCause: MaterialsProvider.register() unconditionally resolved authorizationToken to call registerMaterialsResources(). The real application registers the Authorization plugin (which binds that token) before application providers, but the isolated runtime case in the test passes defineServerPlugins([]), so no plugin provides the token and resolving it throws.
improvements.resolution: MaterialsProvider now only binds its service token in register(); the Authorization composite, database permissions and UI placement are registered in boot(), guarded by container.has(authorizationToken). boot() still runs after every provider's register() and before any provider's start(), so the Authorization provider's startup scan of stored Permission Sets already sees the materials composite, while a runtime without Authorization simply skips it.

improvements.title: Seed-data module not loadable when seeds run from source
improvements.symptom: tests/logic/app-server.test.ts > 'starts a fresh Default without example tables or APIs' and > 'serves Users and API Keys...' failed because database seeds failed: Cannot find module '.../workspace/database/seed-data/permission-sets.js' imported from database/main/seeds/202610010102_seed_material_permission_sets.ts (ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND).
improvements.rootCause: The seed imported database/seed-data/permission-sets.js, and seed-data imported server/materials/resources.js. @nocobase/db loads a seed by dynamic import() outside the bundler, so the imported graph is resolved by native Node, which does not map a relative .js specifier onto its .ts source. tsx handles the mapping in normal development, and tsc rewrites the specifier for dist, so the failure appeared only where the source graph runs under native Node (the standalone app-server tests).
improvements.resolution: Made the seed task graph source-loadable by using .ts specifiers along the only cross-directory chain (seed -> database/seed-data/permission-sets.ts -> server/materials/resources.ts -> server/materials/record-access.ts). tsconfig's rewriteRelativeImportExtensions converts those back to .js when pnpm build emits dist, so the shipped server keeps the same relative layout and the seeds stay derived from the live materials resource reference instead of duplicating grant literals.

retro.summary: Browser criterion B00 failed because the requested business feature was never implemented: the application shipped as the untouched default template (placeholder home, no material collection, one built-in admin account, only Atlas in AI Employees). Implemented the read-only 资料助手 end to end: materials + assistantMessages migrations; server-enforced record visibility through the Authorization composite model; a grounded, citation-carrying assistant service that works with or without an AI model service; Hono routes; 资料库 and 资料助手 pages with navigation, a business landing page and bilingual copy; and seeded three fictional materials, two permission sets and two isolated test accounts, all idempotently. Verified against a real SQLite database, including the confidentiality boundary (a colleague cannot read the supervisor-only material on the page or through the assistant), transcript persistence across refresh, and the supervisor-edit/colleague-re-ask flow. Two runtime defects found by the smoke test were fixed before finishing. A later repair round fixed three failing app-server tests caused by the materials provider and the seed-data import.
